Netanyahu sought Iran strikes, Trump vetoed: Report

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reportedly sought to resume strikes against Iran ahead of Israeli elections, but U.S. President Donald Trump vetoed the plan. Netanyahu stated that "toppling" the Iranian government is the only way to end the threat it poses.
